name: Typed ordered-input composition for two-state effective transitions

statement.latest: Phi_j(p)=p_eq,j+(p-p_eq,j)exp[-lambda_j*dt_j], lambda_j=k_plus,j+k_minus,j, p_eq,j=k_plus,j/lambda_j (lambda_j>0); p_AB-p_BA=(1-exp[-lambda_A*dt_A])(1-exp[-lambda_B*dt_B])(p_eq,B-p_eq,A). For zero-rate phases Phi_j(p)=p.
statement.note_ascii: Exact algebra under declared finite piecewise-constant rates, rates >=0, p in [0,1], same units and matching context. Retain intervention order; the physical readout and biological bridge remain uncalibrated and cannot be inferred from this identity.

definitions.p: abstract latent model fraction (0..1), NOT glucose/IL-6 concentration or clinical inflammation
definitions.k_plus: forward transition rate within a declared context and phase, inverse-time
definitions.k_minus: reverse transition rate within same time unit
definitions.p_eq: constant-rate phase equilibrium, defined when lambda>0
definitions.Phi: conditional exact finite-time map in declared model
definitions.R: typed, assay/context/question-specific measurement operator with separate required calibration
definitions.intervention_tape: retained sequence of input phases; aggregate counts lose temporal order

claim_boundary: Exact identity in declared two-state model. Rates in demonstration are illustrative and not fitted to any meal, molecule, clinical endpoint or patient.
